label: Proper-part extensionality: unrestricted and composite-restricted
resolution: Keep the unrestricted and BOTH-composites-restricted principles distinct. DS-3 is a premise-free mixing control: the same full-fusion model satisfies the restricted principle and refutes the unrestricted one, so replacing the former by the latter is invalid. Both predicates are transparent definitions over one supplied partial order, with distinct Lean declarations. IsMin means absence of proper parts here, not the broader metaphysical IsSimple. Neither sense is identified with equality of overlap profiles. These existing predicates also form a strength fork on each SAME carrier and partial order: unrestricted PROPER_PART_EXTENSIONALITY_1 implies composite-restricted PROPER_PART_EXTENSIONALITY_2 by quantifier restriction, certified by restrictedOfUnrestricted and registered as strengthens. The converse fails in the existing Body/DS-3 certificate. Exactly what the strong principle adds is at most one IsMin object; exactDifference certifies STRONG iff WEAK and that uniqueness condition without any background. The latter asserts no minimal-object existence. The labels and definition identities remain unchanged; strength is not an exclusive choice of metaphysical winner.
